Title: Update to Annex K and Annex L Reason for change: Annex K sub-section beam peak scan and spherical scan need to be in separate subsection for clear cross referencing. Currently both are consolidated in same subsection which could result in maintanance issues in case of unique updates needed to only one of the two procedures. TRP in Annex L belongs to Annex K where all measurement procedures are being defined. Summary of change: Restructuring Annex K sub-sections. Moving Annex L contents to Annex K. Consequences if not approved: Reference to spheirical scan is unclear as it is not direct. Potential maintainance issues in future. Clauses affected: Annex K & Annex L
